_comment: Where Nick posts from. Drives the one-tap action links in the digest email. Read at runtime by send_digest.py — edit and the next digest picks it up, no code change and no redeploy.
_identity_note: Nick posts as himself, not as a DailyCoder brand account (confirmed 2026-08-27). Replies stay first-person and lean on 20+ years of actually building software. If this ever changes to 'brand', the voice rules in agent/social-digest.md need updating too.
_mastodon_note: FILL THIS IN — e.g. "fosstodon.org" (no https://, no @). It is the instance Nick's OWN account lives on. With it set, the digest can emit /authorize_interaction links that open a remote post inside his own instance already set up to reply — the difference between one tap and a manual copy-paste-search. Without it the digest degrades gracefully to a plain link to the post on its home server, which still works but takes four more taps.
_bluesky_note: Optional, cosmetic only. Compose intent links work without it.
_enabled_compose_note: Which platforms get a pre-filled compose button for standalone posts. Hacker News and Reddit are deliberately absent: neither has a compose-intent URL, and on both the right move is replying inside an existing thread anyway, which the per-item action link already handles.
